description:
When to use: the caller wants the cost of protecting this portfolio with puts, or how expensive that hedge is relative to the book.

    Inputs: portfolio_id from list_portfolios. The caller's token is the owner scope. Do not pass a user id or a symbol list. The route reads that portfolio's holdings.

    What comes back: the route JSON, unchanged. It prices a one-month put 5 percent out of the money on each holding, plus an index put sized to the book. Costs are in the portfolio currency. A holding with no listed put is named in missing and is not a zero cost. A portfolio the token does not own is the same not-found answer as a missing id.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID from list_portfolios

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: get_portfolio_hedge_cost
title: Get portfolio hedge cost
